Home.title: Fullcar
Home.tagline: Group carpooling, there and back, no account needed.
Home.intro: A match, a wedding, a ski weekend: share one link, and everyone sees who is driving, where seats are free and who still has no car.

create.title: Create the event
create.text: A title, a place, the start time and, if there is a return trip, the end time. No account, no email address.

share.title: Share the link
share.text: By text message or in the group chat. Everyone signs up, offers a car or takes a free seat.

follow.title: See who still has no car
follow.text: A banner shows how many people still have no car, and whether seats are missing.

Home.deleted: Events are deleted 30 days after their date.

Emails.fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

confirmation.subject: Confirm your email address for Fullcar
confirmation.intro: An event has just been created on Fullcar with this address. Confirm it to find the event in My events, on any device:
confirmation.validity: This link is valid for 7 days and works once. Do not forward it: it opens the organiser area, which shows phone numbers.
confirmation.notYou: Wasn’t you? Ignore this email: without a click, this event is linked to no account, and it is deleted, with the address it holds, 30 days after its date.

signIn.subject: Your Fullcar sign-in link
signIn.intro: Here is your link to sign in to Fullcar:
signIn.validity: It is valid for 1 hour and works once. Do not forward it: it gives access to your events.
signIn.notYou: Didn’t ask for anything? Ignore this email: without a click, nobody is signed in.

noAccount.subject: Signing in to Fullcar
noAccount.intro: Someone asked to sign in to Fullcar with this address, but no account is linked to it. An account is created with a first event:
noAccount.notYou: Didn’t ask for anything? Ignore this email: no account was created.

inactivityWarning.subject: Your Fullcar account will be deleted on {date}
inactivityWarning.intro: Your Fullcar account has not been used for almost 3 years. Without a visit by {date}, it will be deleted, along with the history of your events.
inactivityWarning.nothingToDo: To have it deleted, there is nothing to do.
inactivityWarning.leadsTo: The button leads to {url}: it signs nobody in by itself.
